name: Louen Leoncoeur
canonNotes: King of Bretonnia, the Lionheart, a Grail Knight and paragon of chivalry.
Rules a proud feudal realm bound by the Code of Chivalry and the Lady of the Lake.
voiceNotes: Noble, chivalrous and formal; speaks of honour, the Lady and the Code.
Contempt for the dishonourable and the monstrous; gracious to worthy friends.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
